home.heroSubtitle: Request a ride. Hop in. Go.
home.step1Body: Enter your destination and see the fare before you go.
home.step2Body: An independent driver nearby accepts your ride.
home.step3Body: Track your trip in real time until you arrive.
home.citiesBody: In Abidjan, choose your vehicle for a private ride. Everywhere else in Cote d'Ivoire, Woyo matches you with a driver already on the way, at a fixed fare set for your town.
home.safetyBody: Verified drivers, real-time trip tracking, support available whenever you need it.
home.downloadBody: Coming soon on the App Store and Google Play.

ride.heroSubtitle: Private rides in Abidjan. Fixed fares from 200 FCFA everywhere else.
ride.descriptionTitle: Two ways to ride with Woyo
ride.descriptionBody: In Abidjan, book a private ride start to finish with the vehicle of your choice (Moto, Standard, Comfort, XL). Everywhere else in Cote d'Ivoire, Woyo matches you with a driver already heading your way, at a fixed fare set for your town.
ride.modesTitle: The Woyo service, wherever you are
ride.abidjanBody: A private ride, start to finish, with the vehicle of your choice.
ride.restBody: A driver already on the way picks you up, at a fixed fare set for your town.
ride.how2: Woyo matches you with a nearby independent driver
ride.how3: Hop in and ride to your destination
ride.faresBody: In Abidjan, your fare is estimated before you go based on distance. Elsewhere, a fixed fare is set for each town.

drive.heroSubtitle: Become a Woyo driver and accept rides on your own schedule.
drive.how1Body: Create your driver profile and upload your documents (license, registration, insurance).
drive.how2Body: Our team verifies your documents to keep everyone safe.
drive.how3Body: Receive ride requests, navigate with built-in GPS, and collect your earnings.
drive.earnBody: Choose your own hours and accept the rides that work for you. Every ride pays based on the distance and length of the trip.
drive.req2: Vehicle in good condition with registration

safety.heroSubtitle: Every Woyo trip is designed to protect riders and drivers alike.
safety.item1Body: Every driver goes through identity and document verification (KYC) before accepting their first ride.
safety.item2Body: The vehicle's location is tracked for the full duration of the ride.
safety.item3Body: A support team is available to help with any issue during or after a ride.

about.body1: Woyo is a Livbiko brand. In Abidjan, Woyo offers private rides, just like Tekeche. Everywhere else in Cote d'Ivoire, Woyo connects drivers and riders at a fixed fare, making mobility accessible everywhere.
about.body2: Every Woyo driver is independent and verified, for safe, reliable trips in the city and across the rest of the country.
about.body3: Our goal: connecting independent drivers and riders, simply and reliably.

legal.title: Legal
legal.body: The Woyo app's privacy policy and terms of use are available directly within the app. For any questions, contact us.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.intro: At Woyo, we take the protection of your personal data seriously. This policy explains what information we collect, how we use it, and what rights you have.
privacy.section1Body: We collect your contact details (name, phone number, email address) when you create your account; your location while using the app, to match riders with drivers; for drivers, the identity and vehicle documents required for account verification (KYC); the information necessary to process payments; and technical data about your device and your use of the app.
privacy.section2Body: We use this information to provide and improve our services, match riders with drivers, process payments, verify driver identity, keep the platform safe, and communicate with you about your account or your rides.
privacy.section3Body: We do not sell your personal data. Some information may be shared with third-party service providers (payment processing, hosting, support) strictly necessary to operate the app, or with competent authorities where required by law.
privacy.section4Body: Your data is kept for as long as your account is active, or as long as necessary to meet our legal obligations, resolve disputes, and enforce our agreements.
privacy.section5Body: You have the right to access, correct, and delete your personal data. You can exercise these rights from your account settings in the app, or by contacting us using the details below.
privacy.section6Body: We implement reasonable technical and organizational measures to protect your data against unauthorized access, alteration, disclosure, or destruction.
privacy.section7Body: We may update this privacy policy from time to time. Any changes will be posted on this page with a revised update date.
privacy.contactBody: If you have any questions about this privacy policy, please contact us.

footer.tagline: Independent drivers, rides across Cote d'Ivoire.
